mapper.insert: INSERT INTO KNOWLEDGE_INGESTION_JOB ( TENANT_ID, JOB_ID, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, USER_ID, SCOPES_JSON, DEPARTMENT, TRACE_ID, DOCUMENT_ID, DISPLAY_NAME, CATEGORY, DOCUMENT_VERSION, NEW_DOCUMENT, REVISION, SOURCE_BUCKET, SOURCE_OBJECT_KEY, SOURCE_HASH, SOURCE_CONTENT_TYPE, SOURCE_SIZE, STATUS, SINKS_JSON, REQUIRED_SINKS_JSON, ERROR_TEXT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, RETRY_COUNT, NEXT_RETRY_AT, ERROR_CODE, FAILED_STAGE, LEASE_OWNER, LEASE_UNTIL, PREPARATION_JSON ) VALUES (#{tenantId},#{jobId},#{idempotencyKey},#{userId},#{scopesJson},#{department},#{traceId},#{documentId},#{displayName},#{category},#{documentVersion},#{newDocument},#{revision},#{sourceBucket},#{sourceObjectKey},#{sourceHash},#{sourceContentType},#{sourceSize},#{status},#{sinksJson},#{requiredSinksJson},#{errorText},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt},#{retryCount},#{nextRetryAt},#{errorCode},#{failedStage},#{leaseOwner},#{leaseUntil},#{preparationJson})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM KNOWLEDGE_INGESTION_JOB WHERE DELETED=0 AND (TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND JOB_ID=#{jobId})

SELECT * FROM KNOWLEDGE_INGESTION_JOB WHERE DELETED=0 AND ((STATUS IN ('PARTIAL','FAILED') AND (NEXT_RETRY_AT IS NULL OR NEXT_RETRY_AT <= #{nextRetryAt})) OR (STATUS='PROCESSING' AND ((LEASE_UNTIL IS NOT NULL AND LEASE_UNTIL <= #{leaseUntil}) OR (LEASE_UNTIL IS NULL AND UPDATED_AT < #{updatedAt})))) ORDER BY UPDATED_AT LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM KNOWLEDGE_INGESTION_JOB WHERE DELETED=0 AND (TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=#{idempotencyKey})
SELECT MIN(CREATED_AT) FROM KNOWLEDGE_INGESTION_JOB WHERE DELETED=0 AND (STATUS IN ('RECEIVED','PROCESSING','PARTIAL','FAILED'))

SELECT TENANT_ID, JOB_ID, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, USER_ID, SCOPES_JSON, DEPARTMENT, TRACE_ID, DOCUMENT_ID, DISPLAY_NAME, CATEGORY, DOCUMENT_VERSION, NEW_DOCUMENT, REVISION, SOURCE_BUCKET, SOURCE_OBJECT_KEY, SOURCE_HASH, SOURCE_CONTENT_TYPE, SOURCE_SIZE, STATUS, SINKS_JSON, REQUIRED_SINKS_JSON, ERROR_TEXT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, RETRY_COUNT, NEXT_RETRY_AT, ERROR_CODE, FAILED_STAGE, LEASE_OWNER, LEASE_UNTIL, PREPARATION_JSON FROM KNOWLEDGE_INGESTION_JOB WHERE DELETED=0 AND (1=0)
SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM KNOWLEDGE_INGESTION_JOB WHERE DELETED=0 GROUP BY STATUS
